TDNT.description: Tendon Property (TDNT). Field applicability is driven by TYPE (internal/external), LT (pre/post-tension) and especially the relaxation method code RM, which selects the relaxation-factor, wobble and CEB-FIP/USER-defined subfields.

TYPE.description: Tendon placement type (case-insensitive). "INTERNAL" maps to internal tendon, "EXTERNAL" to external tendon.

AREA.description: Total tendon (strand) cross-section area. Required by the write path when the tendon uses a user-defined design code (the default); a value change is accepted only in that case.

D_AREA.description: Duct area/diameter. Post-tension: duct diameter; Pre-tension: strand diameter; External: not used.

LT.description: Tensioning (load) type (case-insensitive). "PRE" maps to pre-tension (load type 0), "POST" to post-tension (load type 1). Not used for external tendons.

ASB.description: Anchorage slip at begin end. Post-tension/External: used; Pre-tension: not used.

ASE.description: Anchorage slip at end. Post-tension/External: used; Pre-tension: not used.

bBONDED.description: Bonded flag. true = bonded (bond type 0), false = unbonded (bond type 1). Post-tension: used; Pre-tension/External: not used.

ALPHA.description: External-cable moment magnifier (alpha). External: used; Pre/Post-tension: not used.

RM.description: Relaxation method code (integer). Selects the relaxation model and thereby which additional fields apply: RV (relaxation coefficient/ratio) for most codes; FT/LR/FPK/bOSRF for JTG04-family codes; TDMFNAME for the user-defined code; wobble fields (W_TYPE/WF/W_ANGLE) for CEB-FIP/European/Israeli/ABNT codes. e.g. 0 = Magura.

RV.description: Relaxation coefficient (or relaxation ratio, depending on RM). Applies to the relaxation-coefficient codes (e.g. Magura, India IRC18-2000, European, KSCE LSD15, India IRC112-2011, ABNT NBR 6118-2023, Israel SI466-3); otherwise carries the relaxation ratio.

FT.description: [RM=JTG04-family] Relaxation coefficient factor. Applies when RM is one of JTG04, TB05, TB10092-17, QCR9300-18, AS 1500.5-2017.

TDMFK.description: Time-dependent material (relaxation function) key. Applies when RM is NOT the user-defined code.

bOSRF.description: [RM=JTG04-family] Apply over-stress reduction factor. Applies when RM is one of JTG04, TB05, TB10092-17, QCR9300-18, AS 1500.5-2017.

LR.description: [RM=JTG04-family] Low-relaxation flag. Applies when RM is one of JTG04, TB05, TB10092-17, QCR9300-18, AS 1500.5-2017.

FPK.description: [RM=JTG04-family] Characteristic value of strength (fpk). Applies when RM is one of JTG04, TB05, TB10092-17, QCR9300-18, AS 1500.5-2017.

bRELAX.description: Relaxation-coefficient check-box flag (read-only indicator derived from the relaxation data; not consumed by the write path).

TDMFNAME.description: [RM=USER_DEFINED] Time-dependent (relaxation) material function name. Required when RM is the user-defined code; the name must reference an existing relaxation function.

FF.description: Curvature friction factor. Post-tension/External: used; Pre-tension: not used.

W_TYPE.description: [RM=CEB-FIP/European/Israeli/ABNT] Wobble input type: 0 = wobble friction factor (WF), 1 = unintentional angular displacement (W_ANGLE). Applies when RM is one of CEB-FIP 1978/1990/2010, European, Israel SI466-3, ABNT NBR 6118-2023.

WF.description: Wobble friction factor. Used when W_TYPE = 0. Post-tension: used; Pre-tension/External: not used.

W_ANGLE.description: [W_TYPE=1] Unintentional angular displacement. Post-tension/External: used; Pre-tension: not used.
